## SEEN Required Reading Gate

Protected-path changes must complete this checklist before merge.

### Required reading

- [ ] I read `README_CORE_SCHEMA_ORDER.md`.
- [ ] I read `docs/00_START_HERE_CANON_LOCK.md`.
- [ ] I read `docs/01_SEEN_FOUNDATION_AND_THREE_COORDINATES.md`.
- [ ] I read `docs/10_SCHEMA_REVIEW_PROTOCOL.md`.
- [ ] I read the file being changed.
- [ ] I checked adjacent files in the core order when applicable.

### Structural contract

- [ ] Input exists, or this file is non-runtime canon/documentation.
- [ ] Output exists, or this file is non-runtime canon/documentation.
- [ ] Handoff target exists when runtime applies.
- [ ] Load order is clear.
- [ ] Hidden mechanics boundary is clear.
- [ ] User-facing boundary is clear.
- [ ] Forbidden moves are clear.

### Product and canon review

- [ ] Closure & Composure remains served.
- [ ] SEEN mission, vision, and purpose remain served.
- [ ] Hormozi value review passes.
- [ ] Socratic contradiction review passes.
- [ ] 80/20 necessity review passes.
- [ ] This change is unlikely to create avoidable future rework.

### Summary

Explain what changed and why this directly helps ship SEEN:
